messages:
Mia Chen: Quick sync 11 we need final decisions on tier boundaries for next sprint. core ask: unbundle compute credits from QoS (so throughput/SLA are purchasable independently) and avoid churn for current commit customers.
Jordan Patel: Sales want simple packs: Commit + Performance + Priority Lane. customers hate per-route knobs. can we make one-line addon pricing? :thumbsup: 
Devin Ortega: Draft packs: Base = model access + basic rate limits; Performance Addon = reserved throughput + burst reservoir; Priority Lane = p95 SLA + routing priority. softfloor guaranteed per commit; burst hard cap.
Samira Khan: Partner note: resellers need monthly addon line-items. AcmeHealth pilot requests dedicated priority lane + on-prem discount; allow negotiable multipliers in SOWs.
Lexi Rivera (Legal): Legal guardrails: SLA credits limited by liability cap; no mid-contract pack-economy changes without 60d notice and opt-out; reseller discounts must be in SOW and not backdated.
pricing-bot: rough sim:
Base: $0.0008/token
Perf Addon: +$X/hr per reserved vGPU equiv
Priority Lane: +20% unit price OR +$Y/mo per route
Estimated uplift: 8-14% revenue; margin delta 10-18% depending on mix.
Jordan Patel: Sales preference: fixed monthly addon pricing for resellers; usage-based for self-serve 1 keeps quoting simple.
Devin Ortega: Billing Q for Priority Lane: fixed monthly vs per-request surcharge. Fixed is easy to sell; per-use aligns economics and prevents overcommit.
Samira Khan: Pilots prefer fixed monthly to simplify budgeting; accept some margin hit.
Lexi Rivera (Legal): Contract language: add 'No retroactive pricing adjustments for active commitments' and a change-control clause. cap aggregate SLA credits per month (recommend 10% of committed fees).
Mia Chen: Proposed pilot launch criteria:
- 3 pilot customers: 1 reseller, 1 enterprise, 1 self-serve
- KPI: Priority Lane p95 < 200ms
- KPI: Cost delta for chatbot workload < 15% vs baseline
- KPI: Pilot -> paid conversion or documented feedback within 90 days
- Ops: console metrics + alerting + rollout playbook
Jordan Patel: Timeline: internal pilot 2w, customer pilots w3-6, canary w7, GA ~w9-10.
Devin Ortega: Impl notes: need router policy update, quota service changes, billing SKU addition. I'll open infra tickets.
Samira Khan: Sales action: assemble pilot customers + target commercial terms this week.
Lexi Rivera (Legal): I'll draft SLA cap & change-control clauses; need concrete price ranges to finish.
Mia Chen: Action items:
- Devin: infra tickets + SKU draft (due EOW)
- Jordan/Samira: pilot list + commercial terms (due in 3 days)
- Lexi: contract clauses draft (due in 4 days)
- Pricing-bot/Product: run 3 workload sims and share sensitivity table (due EOW)
Thanks 1 reconvene after artifacts. :rocket:
